senses.definition: Any fictional crime-fighting character, often with supernatural powers or equipment, in popular children's and fantasy literature; a fictional hero who does great things.

quotes.text:
Hobbes: Super heroes wear snow pants?
Stupendous Man: When there's snow out, they do!

senses.definition: (by extension) A particularly renowned real-world hero, or one who has seemingly impossible abilities.
examples: The power is out but you're watching TV? You must be a superhero.
Thanks for driving out here and towing me out of the ditch. You're a superhero!

quotes.text: Did you know your community has many invisible superheroes? Each day they perform hundreds of amazing feats that make the community a better place in which to live.
